items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: So Jimmy was playing with him, you know. And we was in the league up there.

ctx.x: Yeah but there's no such person as Gibson huh? No. Just made that up huh? Yeah. That's a kick. The Gibson band.

See because before it was named after Jackson, it was the Jackson band. You know what I'm saying? Yeah. Jimmy had a name behind him. His name was Alphonse Spears. I guess you didn't want to say Spears band, the name of the Egyptian band.
